title: A Lost Ship
question: Did the crew of the Elkor find what they were looking for? Why?

meanings.usage: 指从沉船或废墟中救出财物
指船上的所有工作人员
指国家的主体部分，不包括岛屿
指未经加工的贵重金属
指用工具或方法仔细搜寻某区域
形容规模或程度非常大
常用复数形式，指个人物品
指一起旅行或被护送的船队或车队
记录船舶航行情况的日志
指能在水下航行的船只
sink的过去分词作形容词用
指将零散的信息拼凑成完整画面

examples.en: The captain was instructed to give up the search.
There was tremendous excitement on board.
The crew were at first under the impression that the lost ship had been found.
examples.zh: 船员们最初以为找到了那艘失踪的船。

examples.en: The numerous items were brought to the surface.
The captain was able to piece together all the information.
examples.zh: 船长能够拼凑出所有的信息。

examples.en: Information that had come to light was collected.
examples.zh: 被揭露的信息被收集起来。

examples.en: The captain of the Elkor ordered his men to salvage as much as possible.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号船长命令他的手下尽可能多地打捞。

examples.en: Elkor had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号已经在巴伦支海搜索了数周。

examples.en: What they had in fact found was a ship which had been sunk many years before.
examples.zh: 他们实际上发现的是一艘很多年前沉没的船。

examples.en: This was later confirmed by a naval official.
examples.zh: 这后来被一位海军官员证实。

sentences.en: The salvage operation had been a complete failure.
sentences.zh: 打捞行动彻底失败了。

sentences.en: The small ship, Elkor, which had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks, was on its way home.
sentences.zh: “埃尔科”号这艘小船在巴伦支海域搜寻了几个星期后，正在返航的途中。

sentences.en: A radio message from the mainland had been received by the ship's captain instructing him to give up the search.
sentences.zh: 船长收到了一份来自大陆的电报，指示他放弃搜寻。

sentences.en: The captain knew that another attempt would be made later,
sentences.zh: 船长知道以后还会再进行一次尝试，

sentences.en: for the sunken ship he was trying to find had been carrying a precious cargo of gold bullion.
sentences.zh: 因为他试图寻找的那艘沉船载有一批珍贵的金条。

sentences.en: Despite the message, the captain of the Elkor decided to try once more.
sentences.zh: 尽管收到那份电报，“埃尔科”号的船长还是决定再试一次。

sentences.en: The sea bed was scoured with powerful nets and there was tremendous excitement on board when a chest was raised from the bottom.
sentences.zh: 海底被强力拖网仔细搜寻，当一个箱子从海底被捞上来时，船上的人都非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Though the crew were at first under the impression that the lost ship had been found,
sentences.zh: 虽然船员们最初以为找到了那艘失踪的船，

sentences.en: the contents of the chest proved them wrong.
sentences.zh: 但箱子里的东西证明他们错了。

sentences.en: What they had in fact found was a ship which had been sunk many years before.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们找到的是一艘多年前就已经沉没的船。

sentences.en: The chest contained the personal belongings of a seaman, Alan Fielding.
sentences.zh: 箱子里装着一个名叫艾伦·菲尔丁的海员的个人物品。

sentences.en: There were books, clothing and photographs, together with letters which the seaman had once received from his wife.
sentences.zh: 里面有书、衣服和照片，还有海员以前从他妻子那里收到的信件。

sentences.en: The captain of the Elkor ordered his men to salvage as much as possible from the wreck.
sentences.zh: “埃尔科”号的船长命令他的船员尽可能多地从残骸中打捞物品。

sentences.en: Nothing of value was found,
sentences.zh: 没找到什么有价值的东西，

sentences.en: but the numerous items which were brought to the surface proved to be of great interest.
sentences.zh: 但打捞上来的许多物品却引起了人们极大的兴趣。

sentences.en: From a heavy gun that was raised, the captain realized that the ship must have been a cruiser.
sentences.zh: 从打捞上来的一门重型火炮，船长意识到这艘船一定是一艘巡洋舰。

sentences.en: In another chest which contained the belongings of a ship's officer,
sentences.zh: 在另一个箱子里，装着一名船上军官的物品，

sentences.en: there was an unfinished letter which had been written on March 14th, 1943.
sentences.zh: 里面有一封写于1943年3月14日、尚未写完的信。

sentences.en: The captain learnt from the letter that the name of the lost ship was the Karen.
sentences.zh: 船长从信中得知那艘失踪的船名叫“卡伦”号。

sentences.en: The most valuable find of all was the ship's log book, parts of which it was still possible to read.
sentences.zh: 最有价值的发现是船上的航海日志，其中一部分仍然可以阅读。

sentences.en: From this the captain was able to piece together all the information that had come to light.
sentences.zh: 从日志中，船长得以把所有已发现的信息拼凑起来。

sentences.en: The Karen had been sailing in a convoy to Russia when she was torpedoed by an enemy submarine.
sentences.zh: “卡伦”号当时正在驶往俄罗斯的护航船队中，结果被一艘敌方潜艇鱼雷击中。

sentences.en: This was later confirmed by a naval official at the Ministry of Defence after the Elkor had returned home.
sentences.zh: “埃尔科”号返回家园后，国防部的一名海军官员证实了这一点。

sentences.en: All the items that were found were sent to the War Museum.
sentences.zh: 所有找到的物品都被送往战争博物馆。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经开始并持续到该时刻的动作，或刚刚结束的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述持续进行的动作，常与for/during等时间词连用，强调动作的持续性

examples.en: Elkor had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号已经在巴伦支海搜索了数周。

grammar.title: 过去完成时被动态 (Past Perfect Passive)
grammar.definition: 过去完成时的被动语态，表示在过去某时刻之前已经完成且承受动作的主语
grammar.usage: 强调动作的完成性和被动性，主语是动作的承受者
